title.en: What leaves a class follows its line

statement.en: Under a class constant up to the net's end, what leaves the class at a member follows every alike occurrence that conditions anything, and one that conditions something but nothing alike to that effect breaks the condition; such a class can leave a member's effects out.
statement.zh: 于至网之终有常之类下，一员处出类者随每一有所缘之同类者；有所缘而无与该效同类者之同类者破此条件；此类可不持一员之所缘。

laws.en: Under a class constant up to the net's end, where a member conditions something not alike to it, every occurrence alike to the member that conditions anything conditions something alike to that effect and outside the class, every one on its line in particular. This is nearly the definition read at a member whose effects the class does not hold.
laws.zh: 于至网之终有常之类下，一员缘一不与之同类者时，凡与此员同类而有所缘者，皆缘一与该者同类而在类外者，其线上之每一者尤然。此几即定义，读于类不持其所缘之员。

laws.en: Where an occurrence alike to such a member conditions something but nothing alike to its outside effect, the class is not constant up to the net's end; a witness.
laws.zh: 与此员同类之一事有所缘而无与其类外之效同类者时，该类不至网之终有常；有见证。
declarations: Becoming.«出类不随则不至终有常»

laws.en: In a finite net without cycles, a class holding a member and part of what follows it can be constant up to the net's end though not constant, not holding the member's effects, while something outside it follows every occurrence on its line that conditions anything; a witness.
laws.zh: 于无环之有限之网中，含一员及其后之一部之类，可至网之终有常而非有常，不持此员之所缘，而其线上每一有所缘者皆有类外者随之；有见证。

hypotheses.en: No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: for every carrier, relation and class; the witnesses' nets supplied, with discrete steps and equality on their carriers.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理，除各律所带者外不加前提：对一切载体、关系与类；见证之网为所给，设离散之步与载体上之相等。

does_not_show.en: That any effect is intended: the laws concern any class that does not hold a member's effects, and the agent reading is a reading.
does_not_show.zh: 任何效为所意：诸律关乎任何不持一员所缘之类，以之读行动者为一读法。

does_not_show.en: That what leaves the class is of one kind beyond what the class distinguishes, or forms a regularity of its own.
does_not_show.zh: 出类者于类所别之外为同一种，或自成一理。

does_not_show.en: That the necessary condition suffices for constancy up to the net's end: even with two blocks what stays in the class must follow too (a two-block net, checked in OC4's review), and with more than two what leaves must follow as something alike to it, not only as something outside (a three-block net, checked in the IV3 line's review of PF2).
does_not_show.zh: 此必要条件足以至网之终有常：即使二块，留于类内者亦须随之（二块之网，见 OC4 之审查）；多于二块时，出类者须以与之同类者随之，非仅以类外者（三块之网，见 IV3 线对 PF2 之审查）。

does_not_show.en: Whether intention fixes whose losses count (the path's P4).
does_not_show.zh: 所意能否定谁之所失计入（此路之 P4）。

next_delta.en: Answered for P2 in constancy-read-at-a-members-class (OC1, reviewed in OC2): read at one's own class with the split, which asks least where a predicate decides the class, P2 asks exactly that what stays and what leaves follow every alike occurrence that conditions anything. Reading P2 so is argued, not proved; whether actual agents meet it is a correspondence; P4's question is put to philosophers.
next_delta.zh: P2 之问于 constancy-read-at-a-members-class（OC1，OC2 复审）得答：读于自之类、取二分（一谓词判其类时所问最少），P2 所问恰为留者与出者皆随每一有所缘之同类者。如此读 P2 乃论之，非证得；实际行动者是否合之为一对应；P4 之问交哲学家。

correspondence.en: Read with a class drawn by what a member intends, the agential self of the path: it can pass P2, and then, leaving some of its effects out, leaves something outside at every alike occurrence that conditions anything, so P2 does not exclude it and P4 carries the crux. A second round of philosophical work is in the PF2 study.
correspondence.zh: 以所意划之类读之，即此路之行动者之自：可过 P2，过则因遗其所缘之一部，每一有所缘之同类者皆有所遗于类外，故 P2 不排除之，关键在 P4。哲学之第二轮工作见 PF2 之研究。
